doc: Boss script for Halloween (kind 500), a large robot fought in an arena. It smashes the ground for Vanguard shockwaves, fires nose bombs (RoBombs, kind 1000) and homing robot missiles, jumps across the arena, lays Flotsam Balloon eggs (kind 25) and climbs the wall. When stunned it collapses for 120 frames and plays event 530 the first time; its death runs event 520.
